options.content:
**Scope & caveats:**

- **AI usage/activity figures on this dashboard come from Claude Code OTel** and are scoped through the connection-to-project mapping and the Project/Claude Code OTel Teams filters above. Activity totals use `canonical_activity` rows; model-usage totals come from `ai_model_usages`. Legacy Claude Admin-API and Cursor activity are excluded — neither carries a reliable per-project mapping, so mixing them in made the “Company-wide” figures uncomparable to the project-scoped delivery panels below.
- **Active Hours** is queried directly from Claude Code's OTel telemetry, not the shared `ai_activities` table — session duration isn't rolled up into the domain layer for any provider.
- **Commits/code churn in closed, unmerged PRs** require at least one closed PR and no merged or open PR association for the same commit SHA in the same base repository. All commit/PR checks use the PR base repository; PRs in another repository do not affect qualification. Closed-PR commit counts come directly from recorded PR associations without requiring repository history or commit metadata; closed-PR churn requires commit metadata, so it can cover fewer commits. Each SHA is counted once per panel if any selected accessible repository qualifies. A SHA shared across repositories can therefore qualify in both categories; these totals should not be added as disjoint sets.
- **Commits/code churn without recorded PRs** have no recorded PR association of any status in a qualifying repository, and are not a merged PR's merge commit there. This includes branches without PRs and direct-to-default-branch commits; it does not prove the commits never reached main or bypassed review. Counts depend on complete commit/PR ingestion, and historical associations may remain after branch history changes. Equivalent code can ship under another SHA (for example, through squashing or cherry-picking). Known overcounts: rebase-merged PRs (every rewritten commit except the merge result), GitLab MRs that are squashed and also get a merge commit (DevLake stores only the merge commit, so the squash commit looks unassociated; a backend fix is tracked separately), and merges of PRs that DevLake never collected.
- **Reporting periods and line counts:** PRs Closed, Never Merged and the closed-PR commit/churn panels use PR closure dates; commits may have been created before the selected period. The merged-PR exclusion checks all dates. Panels without recorded PRs use commit dates and check PR associations across all dates, so their reporting periods differ from the closed-PR panels. Code churn is shown in lines (additions + deletions), counted once per SHA, and only covers commits with additions/deletions metadata; it shows no data when none of the qualifying commits have it. Repeated edits are counted; this is not unique abandoned code.
- **PR Abandonment Rate** is the delivery-outcome view of the same problem: no field links an AI session to the branch or PR it produced, so a dollar/token cost can't be attached to abandoned work directly. This table measures it a different way instead — PR-level: (PRs authored that closed without merging) ÷ (all PRs authored) — as an outcome-based proxy for wasted effort, not an AI-cost-denominated one.
- **Developer filter:** AI figures match the developer's OTel email. PR and closed-PR figures match the PR author's GitHub account, and commit figures match the commit email, using the GitHub account that GitHub itself links to the developer's OTel email through their commits. Developers marked *no GitHub link* have no commits under their OTel email in the collected GitHub repos, so their PR and commit figures are empty rather than zero output; *no AI data* marks PR authors without OTel activity. An email that GitHub links to more than one account counts as *no GitHub link*. Account IDs are assumed to come from a single GitHub host (github.com).

panels.description: Total AI tokens consumed, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_model_usages.*_tokens)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS "Tokens Burned"
FROM ai_model_usages
WHERE source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
)
AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))

panels.title: Tokens Burned

panels.description: Total Claude Code OTel sessions, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.num_sessions)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(num_sessions) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR user_email IN ($developer_emails))

panels.title: Claude Sessions

panels.description: Total active engineering hours logged by Claude Code, from OTel telemetry, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). Not available at the domain layer for any provider.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ha.active_time_seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Active Hours"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity ha
WHERE ha.connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
)
AND $__timeFilter(ha.hour_start) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR ha.user_email IN ($developer_emails))

panels.title: Active Hours

  )

panels.title: AI Lines Removed

panels.description: Merged pull requests, scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Merged"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))

panels.title: PRs Merged

panels.description: Distinct pull requests closed without merging, scoped to the selected project(s), using PR closure dates. Closed-PR commit/churn panels use the same date field; panels without recorded PRs use commit dates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS "PRs Closed, Never Merged"
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'CLOSED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))

panels.title: PRs Closed, Never Merged

panels.description: Distinct recorded commit SHAs in PRs closed during the selected period, scoped by PR base repository to the selected project(s), excluding SHAs that are also in a merged or open PR in the same base repository, across any date. Includes associations without commit metadata; recorded associations do not prove code was abandoned.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
active_shas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, prc.commit_sha AS sha
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.status IN ('MERGED', 'OPEN')
),
closed_shas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT prc.commit_sha AS sha
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  LEFT JOIN active_shas act ON act.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id AND act.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.status = 'CLOSED'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
    AND act.sha IS NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Commits in Closed, Unmerged PRs",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND COUNT(c.additions) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(c.additions, 0) + COALESCE(c.deletions, 0)), 0)
  END AS "Code Churn in Closed, Unmerged PRs"
FROM closed_shas s
LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.sha = s.sha

panels.title: Commits in Closed, Unmerged PRs

panels.description: Total code churn in lines (additions + deletions), counted once per commit from Commits in Closed, Unmerged PRs. Only commits with additions/deletions metadata in the commits table contribute, so churn is undercounted when metadata is missing; it shows no data when none of the qualifying commits have metadata. Repeated edits and changes shipped elsewhere are included.
panels.title: Code Churn (Lines) in Closed, Unmerged PRs

names: Code Churn in Closed, Unmerged PRs

panels.description: Distinct commits in the selected project(s)' repositories, by commit date, that have no recorded PR association of any status and are not a merged PR's merge commit in the same base repository. Rebase-merged PR commits, squash commits from GitLab MRs that also have a merge commit, and merges of PRs that were never collected can inflate the count; this does not prove direct pushes to main.

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
pr_shas AS (
  SELECT pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, prc.commit_sha AS sha
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
  UNION
  SELECT mpr.base_repo_id, mpr.merge_commit_sha
  FROM pull_requests mpr
  WHERE mpr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND mpr.status = 'MERGED' AND mpr.merge_commit_sha <> ''
),
no_pr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, c.additions, c.deletions
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  JOIN scoped_repos s ON s.repo_id = rc.repo_id
  LEFT JOIN pr_shas p ON p.repo_id = rc.repo_id AND p.sha = c.sha
  WHERE p.sha IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(c.committed_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer_emails) OR c.author_email IN ($developer_emails))
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Commits Without PRs",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND COUNT(additions) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(additions, 0) + COALESCE(deletions, 0)), 0)
  END AS "Code Churn Without Recorded PRs"
FROM no_pr

panels.title: Commits Without PRs

panels.description: Total code churn in lines (additions + deletions), counted once per commit from Commits Without PRs. Only commits with additions/deletions metadata contribute; it shows no data when none of the qualifying commits have metadata. Churn is not unique abandoned code.
panels.title: Code Churn (Lines) Without Recorded PRs

panels.description: Neutral bars: PRs merged that week. Orange bars: PRs closed that week without being merged. Both are PR counts on one shared axis. Hover for the abandonment rate: closed ÷ (merged + closed). Completed weeks only; weeks begin Monday, and weeks with no data show as zero. Uses the Project filter and follows the Developer filter; the OTel Teams filter does not apply.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE merged AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS n
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
  GROUP BY 1
),
closed AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.closed_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.closed_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS n
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'CLOSED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date) AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
  GROUP BY 1
),
wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY) AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM wk WHERE DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY) < $__timeTo()
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS week FROM wk
  WHERE TIMESTAMP(d) >= $__timeFrom() AND TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) <= DATE_ADD($__timeTo(), INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(w.week, '%b %e') AS "Week",
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(c.n, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(m.n, 0) + COALESCE(c.n, 0), 0), 1) AS "Abandonment rate",
  COALESCE(m.n, 0) AS "PRs merged",
  COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS "PRs closed, never merged"
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN merged m ON m.week = w.week
LEFT JOIN closed c ON c.week = w.week
ORDER BY w.week

panels.title: PRs Merged and Closed Without Merging (Weekly)

panels.description: PR-level, not commit/branch-level: (PRs authored that closed without merging) ÷ (all PRs authored), scoped to the selected project(s), minimum 5 PRs authored in range to avoid noisy small-sample rates. Measures delivery outcome, not AI-specific cost. Each PR is counted once even when its repository maps to several selected projects.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name) AS "Contributor",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total PRs",
  SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') AS "Abandoned (Closed, Never Merged)",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Abandonment Rate %"
FROM pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))) AND pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED') AND COALESCE(pr.merged_date, pr.closed_date) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: PR Abandonment Rate by Contributor

panels.description:
Merged pull requests in the selected project(s) and time range, by merge date, with one row per repository and author, most PRs first. Use it to compare how much each person merged and how much of it Claude co-authored.

- **PRs** is the number of merged PRs.
- **Branches** counts the distinct head branches those PRs were merged from.
- **Approvers** counts the distinct reviewers whose latest approve, request-changes or dismissed review on at least one of the PRs is an approval, so an approval that was later withdrawn or dismissed isn't counted. GitHub reviews and GitLab approvals are recorded; Bitbucket and Bitbucket Server PRs count none.
- **Files Changed** counts distinct file paths across the PRs' single-parent commits, which include a squash or rebase merge result, so a file touched by several PRs counts once. A two-parent merge commit is skipped. It needs commit file data from the git extractor (`SKIP_COMMIT_FILES=false`; the default is `true`) and shows *n/a* when none of the PRs' commits have it. For rebase-merged PRs whose branch was deleted, only the last rebased commit is in the clone, so the count is low.
- **Claude Co-Authored** is the share of PRs where any commit, or the merge commit, has a `Co-Authored-By:` line with `noreply@anthropic.com`. Commit messages come from the cloned repository and, for GitHub, from the PR commits the GitHub plugin collects, so squash- and rebase-merged PRs are still checked after their branch is deleted. PRs with no commit message found are left out of the percentage, and it shows *Unknown* when none of the PRs have one. Release and back-merge PRs carry every commit they promote, so they count when any of those commits are co-authored.

targets.rawSql:
WITH prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id, pr.pull_request_key, pr.url, pr.title, pr.head_ref, pr.author_id, pr.author_name, pr.merged_date, pr.merge_commit_sha
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm.row_id FROM project_mapping pm WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)))
    AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
    AND ('__all' IN ($developer) OR (pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) IN ($developer)))
),
pr_commits AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, prc.commit_sha FROM pull_request_commits prc WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM prs)
  UNION
  SELECT id, merge_commit_sha FROM prs WHERE merge_commit_sha <> ''
),
claude AS (
  SELECT m.pull_request_id, SUM(m.claude) AS commits
  FROM (
    SELECT pc.pull_request_id, CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4) LIKE '%noreply@anthropic.com%' AND REGEXP_LIKE(CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4), 'co-authored-by:.*noreply@anthropic[.]com', 'i') AS claude
    FROM pr_commits pc JOIN commits c ON c.sha = pc.commit_sha
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pc.pull_request_id, gc.message LIKE '%noreply@anthropic.com%' AND REGEXP_LIKE(gc.message, 'co-authored-by:.*noreply@anthropic[.]com', 'i')
    FROM pr_commits pc JOIN _tool_github_commits gc ON gc.sha = pc.commit_sha
  ) m
  GROUP BY m.pull_request_id
),
file_commits AS (
  SELECT pc.pull_request_id, pc.commit_sha
  FROM pr_commits pc
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commit_files cf WHERE cf.commit_sha = pc.commit_sha)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = pc.commit_sha) <= 1
),
files AS (
  SELECT prs.base_repo_id, prs.author_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.file_path) AS files
  FROM prs
  JOIN file_commits fc ON fc.pull_request_id = prs.id
  JOIN commit_files cf ON cf.commit_sha = fc.commit_sha
  GROUP BY prs.base_repo_id, prs.author_id
),
latest_reviews AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, c.account_id, c.status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.pull_request_id, c.account_id ORDER BY c.created_date DESC, c.id DESC) AS rn
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  WHERE c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'DISMISSED') AND c.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM prs)
),
approvers AS (
  SELECT prs.base_repo_id, prs.author_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lr.account_id) AS approvers
  FROM latest_reviews lr JOIN prs ON prs.id = lr.pull_request_id
  WHERE lr.rn = 1 AND lr.status = 'APPROVED'
  GROUP BY prs.base_repo_id, prs.author_id
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT prs.base_repo_id, prs.author_id, MAX(prs.author_name) AS author_name,
    COUNT(*) AS prs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT prs.head_ref) AS branches,
    SUM(cl.commits > 0) AS claude_prs,
    COUNT(cl.pull_request_id) AS known_prs
  FROM prs
  LEFT JOIN claude cl ON cl.pull_request_id = prs.id
  GROUP BY prs.base_repo_id, prs.author_id
)
SELECT
  r.name AS "Repository",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(au.full_name, ''), g.author_name) AS "Author",
  g.prs AS "PRs",
  g.branches AS "Branches",
  COALESCE(ap.approvers, 0) AS "Approvers",
  f.files AS "Files Changed",
  100 * g.claude_prs / NULLIF(g.known_prs, 0) AS "Claude Co-Authored"
FROM grouped g
LEFT JOIN repos r ON r.id = g.base_repo_id
LEFT JOIN accounts au ON au.id = g.author_id
LEFT JOIN files f ON f.base_repo_id = g.base_repo_id AND f.author_id <=> g.author_id
LEFT JOIN approvers ap ON ap.base_repo_id = g.base_repo_id AND ap.author_id <=> g.author_id

list.definition:
WITH scoped_conn AS (
  SELECT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE c.status = 'active'
    AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
),
otel AS (
  SELECT user_email AS email FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity' AND user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
  UNION
  SELECT user_email FROM ai_model_usages
  WHERE user_email <> '' AND source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn) AND $__timeFilter(date)
),
linked AS (
  SELECT o.email, MIN(g.author_id) AS gid
  FROM otel o
  JOIN _tool_github_commits g ON g.author_email = o.email AND g.author_id > 0
  GROUP BY o.email
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.author_id) = 1
),
pr_authors AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS gid, MAX(pr.author_name) AS login
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pm.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE '%[bot]'
    AND ($__timeFilter(pr.created_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) OR $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date))
  GROUP BY 1
),
people AS (
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', l.gid) AS k, l.gid, MIN(l.email) AS email, NULL AS login, 1 AS has_ai FROM linked l GROUP BY l.gid
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('em:', o.email), NULL, o.email, NULL, 1 FROM otel o WHERE o.email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM linked)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CONCAT('gh:', p.gid), p.gid, NULL, p.login, 0 FROM pr_authors p WHERE p.gid NOT IN (SELECT gid FROM linked)
),
named AS (
  SELECT p.k, p.has_ai, COALESCE(ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS handle,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ga.name, ''), ga.login, p.login, p.email) AS name
  FROM people p
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(login) AS login, MAX(name) AS name FROM _tool_github_accounts GROUP BY id) ga ON ga.id = p.gid
)
SELECT CONCAT(
    name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY name) > 1 AND handle <> name THEN CONCAT(' (', handle, ')') ELSE '' END,
    CASE WHEN k LIKE 'em:%' THEN ' · no GitHub link' WHEN has_ai = 0 THEN ' · no AI data' ELSE '' END
  ) AS __text,
  k AS __value
FROM named
ORDER BY has_ai DESC, __text;

list.definition:
WITH scoped_conn AS (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
),
scoped_email AS (
  SELECT user_email FROM ai_activities WHERE source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn)
  UNION
  SELECT user_email FROM ai_model_usages WHERE source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM scoped_conn)
),
scoped_gid AS (
  SELECT g.author_id AS gid FROM _tool_github_commits g WHERE g.author_id > 0 AND g.author_email IN (SELECT user_email FROM scoped_email)
  UNION
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED) FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
)
SELECT '__none' AS __value
UNION SELECT '__all' FROM DUAL WHERE '__all' IN ($developer)
UNION SELECT user_email FROM scoped_email WHERE '__all' NOT IN ($developer) AND CONCAT('em:', user_email) IN ($developer)
UNION SELECT g.author_email FROM _tool_github_commits g
  WHERE '__all' NOT IN ($developer) AND g.author_id > 0 AND CONCAT('gh:', g.author_id) IN ($developer)
    AND g.author_id IN (SELECT gid FROM scoped_gid)
    AND g.author_email IN (SELECT author_email FROM _tool_github_commits WHERE author_id > 0 GROUP BY author_email HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) = 1)
